_doc: Difficulty sets offered when making a room. Each changes settings from config/game.json for that room only: a section name (rules, train, avatar, station, levelgen) and the keys to change. An empty set keeps the file's values. Listed in this order on the page; 'default' names the one picked to start with. Easy and hard are first guesses, to be tuned by play. 'test' is not generated: it is the hand-made test run (src/gen/testrun.ts: flat, no black rock, grey rock along the top, trees along the bottom, track piled beside each station), for trying out stations, upgrades, wagons and dynamite quickly; its set changes settings like any other.
